options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains (A). Over 75% of amphibian species and hundreds of tree species found in the Western Ghats are endemic nowhere else on Earth.

Hence, option (A) is the correct choice.
